summary.file_check: Raw files written in the AncestryDNA, 23andMe, MyHeritage, FamilyTreeDNA, Living DNA and VCF layouts (including a GRCh38 VCF) are read back with every genotype exact.
summary.pca: Genomes reduced to about 95,358 SNPs (a genotyping chip's worth) land a median 0.95% of the map's width from where the same genomes land with all 1.15 million SNPs (168 placements of 84 held-out genomes).
summary.neanderthal: On 84 held-out genomes reduced to chip size, the 95% interval contained the estimate from all 1.15 million SNPs in 100% of cases.
summary.ancient_ancestry: Athanor's qpAdm reproduces ADMIXTOOLS qpAdm [0.524, 0.282, 0.195] with [0.524, 0.282, 0.194] on a well-powered simulation: every weight agrees to within 0.0006 and every standard error to within 0.0003, and both recover the simulated proportions [0.5, 0.3, 0.2] to within 0.024. On simulated populations whose true proportions are known, the fitted proportions were within two standard errors of the truth for all 6 populations (largest deviation 0.152).
